About Clipster
Clipster is where brands and creators connect to turn views into profits. Clippers (Creators) clip, remix, and post branded content on TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, X, and beyond — earning money for every view they deliver. Brands get a significantly better influencer marketing experience thanks to scale, simplicity, and reliable performance tracking.
We started as an influencer marketing agency. While clients loved our results, delivering them was a pain. So we started automating everything we did — and it paid off.

s.h: 2025 was a great year for us
s.t:
We launched our platform in early 2025
We grew our team to 35 members
We scaled from 0 to more than 100,000 creators and paid out more than $5M to them
We acquired more than 120 clients solely through word of mouth. Our growth has been 100% organic
We ran campaigns for companies such as Telegram, UFC, Universal Music Group and artists such as Elton John, Ed Sheeran, Playboi Carti, and Kendrick Lamar
We're profitable and have secured our first investor

We are looking for a Backend-Heavy Senior Engineer who isn't afraid to touch the full stack. While your primary domain will be our Golang services and distributed architecture, you are a "Product Engineer" at heart — meaning you understand the "why" behind the code and can jump into the React/Next.js frontend whenever it's the shortest path to delivering value.
The mindset we hire for
Intensity & Grit — You run toward hard problems and stay until they are solved.
Ambitious Simplification — You have the intelligence to solve complex problems and the wisdom to choose the simplest solution.
Ownership & Mission Alignment — You don't "close tickets"; you ship outcomes. You care about the creator economy as much as we do.
AI Readiness — You leverage modern tools to multiply your output and keep us at the cutting edge.
Humility & Collaboration — You are a high-bandwidth communicator who mentors others and leaves your ego at the door.
Your technical toolkit
Core Backend — 5+ years of experience, with at least 3+ years of mastery in Golang. Comfortable with high-performance distributed systems.
Fullstack Versatility — Backend is your home, but you have the skills to navigate and contribute to a React/Next.js frontend.
Infrastructure & Data — Deep knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, and ideally GCP.
Architectural Mindset — You move seamlessly from system design to shipping production-ready code. Clean code, test coverage, and documentation are your tools for maintaining velocity.

Experience with payment systems (we handle around $1M in monthly payouts).
Event-driven architectures and real-time data processing.
Why Clipster
Total ownership - Join a lean tech team of fewer than 15 people. What you build today, millions will use tomorrow.
Remote & async - Work where you are most effective. We only ask for availability during our core hours (10am – 2pm UTC+2).
Zero bureaucracy - No endless meetings. We value documentation, Slack, and Loom for high-bandwidth, low-noise collaboration.
Next steps
Discovery call - a brief chat with our recruiter.
Pair programming - a hands-on session with one of our engineers.
System design - a discussion about an architectural problem, based on our day-to-day problems.
Engineering excellence discussion.
Final meet - chat with our Founder and PM to talk mission and values.

ORDERYOYO Lead Software Engineer – Payments Remote · Quarterly team gatherings in one of our global offices · Competitive salary About the Role At OrderYOYO , payments sit at the heart of everything we do. Every order placed, every restaurant paid, and every dispute resolved runs through the systems this team owns and operates.

We're looking for a Lead Software Engineer – Payments to own the next stage of our payments platform's evolution — as a hands-on technical leader who can grow and manage a team of payments engineers, set the technical direction for a business-critical domain, and support our transition to a more scalable operating model across online ordering and in-store platforms (POS, Kiosk, and payment terminals).

You'll play a central role in shaping how OrderYOYO handles money — from authorisation and settlement to disputes and merchant invoicing — while building and developing the people who make that possible.

Role Mission Lead the people, architecture, and delivery behind OrderYOYO 's payments platform — enabling KYC onboarding, deductions, settlement/payout timing, dispute flows, and merchant invoicing — while growing a high-performing engineering team and raising the bar on reliability, security, and engineering quality in one of our most business-critical domains.

Core Responsibilities People Leadership & Team Development Lead, mentor, and grow a team of payments engineers — providing hands-on technical guidance, regular feedback, and clear paths for career development.
Own hiring and team-building for the payments engineering function, partnering with recruiting to define role profiles, run interviews, and bring in strong talent.
Run day-to-day people management: 1:1s, goal-setting, performance reviews, and career progression conversations for direct reports.
Build a team culture where payments knowledge is documented and shared, not tribal — through design reviews, standards, and mentoring.
Represent the payments engineering team in leadership and cross-functional conversations, translating business needs into technical strategy and team priorities.
Balance hands-on technical contribution with people-management responsibilities, staying close enough to the codebase to lead by example and unblock the team.
Technical & Domain Ownership Set the technical direction and long-term architecture strategy for payment-domain services, including gateway integrations, payment intent/authorisation/capture/refund flows, payout orchestration, and reconciliation.
Oversee marketplace capabilities: onboarding/KYC integration, merchant configuration, settlement instructions, deductions, and invoicing/merchant-statement alignment.
Ensure robust “flow-of-funds” primitives across the team's systems — idempotency, ledgers/events, and audit trails that are fully supportable for finance and compliance.
Own the strategy for PSP and partner integrations, with close attention to tri-party / sub-merchant implications where applicable.
Oversee dispute/chargeback and fraud-handling touchpoints across internal workflows and PSP tooling, and drive collaboration with Ops on runbooks and escalation paths.
Partner closely with Product, Legal/Compliance, Finance, and Support to convert requirements into safe, testable production behaviour.
Raise engineering quality in a high-change domain: automated testing, safe rollouts/canaries, observability, and incident-response improvements, with accountability for outcomes across the team.
Must-Have Requirements Proven experience leading, mentoring, or people-managing a team of software engineers — including hiring, performance management, and career development.
Strong backend engineering background in distributed systems — microservices, async processing, resilient APIs, and eventual consistency.
Production experience with payment flows (auth/capture/refund, webhooks, reconciliation) and “money correctness” patterns such as idempotency keys, double-entry thinking, and auditability.
A solid security mindset: PCI compliance, PII protection, secrets management, least privilege, and secure coding practices.
Comfort working in an Azure-first environment (APIs, queues/eventing, monitoring), with strong CI/CD and automated testing practices.
Clear, confident communication with both engineers and non-technical stakeholders in high-stakes scenarios — incidents, financial breaks, and compliance requests.
Strong judgement on when to move fast, when to standardise, and when to say “not yet” with evidence — balancing team capacity, technical debt, and business priorities.
Strong-to-Have Experience Experience scaling or restructuring an engineering team through periods of growth or organisational change.
Experience with sub-merchant, marketplace, or Payfac-like operating models (KYC, underwriting, settlements, fee deductions).
Familiarity with dispute tooling, card scheme rules, 3DS/risk rules, or fraud platforms.
Experience partnering with Legal, Compliance, or Finance leadership on regulatory or audit requirements.
Who We Are At OrderYOYO , company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build.

Personal development is central to how we work — engineers are encouraged to grow technically, take responsibility, and help shape how our products and platforms evolve. We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps, and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business.

By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably. Through our partnership with AppSmart, the market leader in POS and in-store systems, we've become the largest restaurant-focused platform in Europe. What We Offer
· Competitive salary. A remote role — work from wherever you do your best work, with quarterly in-person gatherings at one of our global offices.
High ownership and autonomy, with a direct hand in shaping the team you lead.
A clear leadership mandate, with scope to grow further into broader engineering management responsibilities.
The opportunity to lead work on revenue-critical production systems.
A strong focus on security, reliability, and engineering best practices.
A collaborative, international engineering team.
Real emphasis on learning, mentoring, and long-term growth — for you and for the people you lead.

Join Apaleo and Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech!
At Apaleo, we're revolutionizing the hospitality industry with our AI-first property management platform, giving businesses the power to build a tech ecosystem that enhances both guest experiences and staff efficiency. With seamless integrations to hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, our platform simplifies operations, elevates the guest journey, and drives revenue growth.
Are you ready to make an impact? We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Python & .NET) (f/m/d) to join our dynamic team and help shape the future of hospitality technology!
What You'll Be Up To
Develop and maintain scalable backend services hosted on AWS with a strong focus on Python-based applications and AI-driven products.
Contribute to full stack development initiatives, including backend APIs and selected frontend components using TypeScript , HTML , and CSS .
Balance speed and quality, ensuring maintainable, reliable, and production-ready code without overengineering .
Mentor and support junior AI engineers by providing technical guidance, architectural feedback, and best practices.
Collaborate closely with product stakeholders, AI engineers, and cross-functional teams to deliver new AI-related products and platform capabilities.
Contribute to future platform initiatives, including potential work within the .NET-based Storefront API ecosystem .

s.h: What You'll Bring to the Team
s.t:
5+ years of professional software engineering experience with strong backend development expertise, including advanced proficiency in Python for building scalable backend systems and production-ready services.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS/ Azure / GCP.
Strong understanding of software architecture, code quality practices, and engineering best practices.
Ability to work independently, take ownership of projects, and operate effectively as a senior individual contributor.
We are looking for candidates with hands-on C#/.NET development experience, given that C#/.NET 10 is our primary backend stack and key to our long-term platform strategy and flexibility.
Strong problem-solving, and collaboration skills, especially within fast-growing engineering teams.
A proactive mindset with the ability to guide junior engineers and help scale engineering excellence across the organization.

Frontend development experience with TypeScript , HTML , and CSS is a plus.
Interest or experience in AI-related products , machine learning, or data engineering environments is beneficial.

Culture & Growth
A Diverse & International Team: Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique cultural perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.
Growth & Development: As we scale, so do your opportunities. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget, and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact.
Autonomy & Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration.
Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech: Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.
Competitive & Fair Compensation: We believe great work deserves great pay. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. We make sure to recognize and reward performance and contribution.

Flexible & Remote Work Options: We focus on results, not clocking hours. You can work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup, with flexibility to adapt your schedule as long as it makes sense for your role, your team and our business.
Free Public Transport: Travel across Germany with ease using our fully covered Deutschland Ticket .
Team Connection: Strong connections fuel collaboration. We celebrate and connect through regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties, and other offsite events.
Paid Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge, and return inspired.
Health & Wellbeing: Prioritize your health with access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios, and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.
How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo means more than just taking on a role, it's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions, and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued, and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation, and growth is a shared journey.

We are building the world's decision infrastructure: the strategic twin of every industrial organization for complex combinatorial problems. We unlocked what wasn't possible before: mapping reality with its levers and constraints into a computer, then running n-dimensional optimization on critical value-chain decisions. We help Europe stay strong and the German Mittelstand make good decisions between market shifts, orders, machines and people.
Founded by Dana (CEO) and Erik (CTO) from RWTH research, backed by a €2.8M round led by Vorwerk Ventures, with customers live on our optimization models.
We move fast. We care. No patience for problems left unsolved.

Hi, I'm Erik, CTO of Circonomit. This ad is specific on purpose: you should be able to tell from it whether this is your job.
We build decision infrastructure for industrial companies: our customers model their production — capacities, costs, constraints — and we compute the answer to "what should we do?" before the decision is made.
Your mission: scale our data platform for multiple customers and domains. Customer data arrives in many formats from many sources, ERP exports included; it has to land in our system consistently, stay manageable at millions of records, and be fast to query when models and results are on screen.

The product is a data-heavy web app with a math-heavy backend (Python, TypeScript, Solid.js, Postgres, on Cloudflare): your center of gravity is data and infrastructure, but you touch the whole stack. We are looking for a system thinker who wants to shape the architecture, and more than that.
We will not sugarcoat it: short deadlines, real workload, and a platform that grows while customers already run on it.
What you'll own
The data platform end to end: ingestion, storage, and the query paths that keep millions of records fast on screen. You design it, you build it, you run it in production.
The platform layer, directly with the CTO: infrastructure, deployments, and the path to production for the whole team.
Performance and correctness work in the optimization engine, together with our research engineers.
Your features from first line to production: nobody hands you a ticket and waits.
How we work
Small team, short lines of communication, no layers. You own your features end to end: you build them, you ship them to production yourself, you run them.
Feedback runs both ways and it runs continuously, in daily work and in weekly one-on-ones. We talk as equals. We communicate proactively and flag it early when something isn't working out. Saying no is part of the job.
We like this work, and you'll notice. The energy of a small team that cares is what people remember about being here. We review each other's code, and we like being together in the Cologne office, because the fastest conversations still happen in a room.

5+ years building production backend or data-intensive systems.
Strong Python and solid TypeScript, with the appetite to work in both daily.
Analytics-data experience: real SQL depth, plus any of Parquet/Arrow/DuckDB/dbt/warehouse internals.
Production PostgreSQL (multi-tenant, migrations, performance).
Data pipelines over heterogeneous sources (ERP exports, Excel, CSV) onto object storage (S3 or comparable), built to keep working as customers and formats grow.
Distributed systems and API design: typical failure modes, HTTP/auth/caching, sane versioning and error behavior.
Engineering craft: design patterns, CI/CD pipelines you set up yourself, prototypes you can throw away.
You have worked in a team, not mostly alone, and you know from experience which agile practices carry their weight.
You have experience working with Linear, Jira, or a similar project management tool.
You communicate proactively, too much rather than too little, and you organize yourself and your work.
German at C1 or better, and fluent English. Team life runs in German; code and docs are English.
NRW-based (Cologne office), optionally Munich, Stuttgart, Berlin area or else willing to work hybrid. Open to find a way if we fit.
Nice to have: a substantial migration you carried out end to end (system, stack, or data) · telemetry and observability · Cloudflare or comparable serverless infrastructure · frontend experience, ideally with Solid.js or another reactive framework · optimization/OR exposure · manufacturing or ERP data experience.
You are structured and biased for action, and you have shown you play to win wherever life has put you so far.
This role is not for you if you want a clearly defined box, or work handed to you in tickets. We are a small team, pre-Series A: structures and processes are still being built, by us and by you. Priorities shift with customers, and some weeks a deadline bends the plan.

Impact. You see your results in the real world, fast. The problems are concrete (production plans, capacities, logistics), and customers can measure in euros what your work changed.
Ownership. What you build, you ship, and you own it once it runs. No layers between you and production, no approval chain that turns your decision into someone else's.
The people next to you. You work directly with the CTO on the platform layer and with our research engineers on the optimization engine, and you build on eye level with the founders.
Shaping. You shape how this team works, not just what it builds. The processes are still forming, and whoever shows up with a better way of doing things gets to install it. This is a place for system thinkers: the interesting part isn't writing the code, it's seeing how the pieces fit and where they'll break. The company is early; your scope will grow with it.
Feedback speed. You will know directly what you are up to, we speak out loud, we adjust, we grow. Together.
High stakes. Competitive salary and relevant room in the equity package (VSOP) to match your contribution and your career development.
The basics. Hardware of your choice · AI tooling budget · sports membership · Deutschland-Ticket.
Process: first conversation, 20 minutes, with me or with the engineer who owns our frontend. Second conversation with the two of us together; this is where the technical questions get deep. Then a hands-on challenge, about three hours of your time, followed by a 45-minute walkthrough where you explain your solution and the decisions behind it.

Finally, the team: online first, then in person at the office. Both sides decide. Two to three weeks end to end, and you hear back within days after each step. Before you decide, ask us to put you on a call with someone who will tell you the good, the bad and the ugly.
To apply: skip the cover letter. Tell us about your favorite system you have built, and one decision in it, you would reverse today.

enyo baut das Energiemanagement fürs Zuhause. Der schwierige Teil daran: Jeder Hersteller spricht sein eigenes Protokoll und alles muss zuverlässig und lokal auf einem kleinen Gerät laufen. Genau daran arbeitest du.
Als Founding Engineer arbeitest du direkt mit unserem CTO an Architektur und technischer Ausrichtung und baust App, Plattform und Energy Apps von Zero to One.
Die Rolle ist in Köln, hybrid mit 3 Tagen pro Woche im Büro.
Aufgaben
Architektur und Vision: Du prägst die technologische Ausrichtung von enyo und baust das Herzstück unseres Systems - App, Plattform, Energy Apps - von Grund auf.
Plattform und Firmware: Du entwickelst eine skalierbare, wartbare API sowie SDKs und programmierst die Intelligenz direkt auf der enyo Box (lokales Processing, Edge Computing, Hardware-Nähe).
Hardware-Integration: Du bindest Wechselrichter, Wärmepumpen, Wallboxen, Batteriespeicher und dynamische Stromtarife an - über Modbus, EEBus, REST und diverse proprietäre Protokolle - und baust dafür Abstraktionen, die eine echte Plug-and-Play-Erfahrung möglich machen.
Produkt und Priorisierung: Du denkst wie ein Produktmensch, priorisierst pragmatisch und findest den Kompromiss zwischen Perfektion und Geschwindigkeit.
Tech-Leadership: Du setzt unsere technische Vision um und baust perspektivisch das Tech-Team mit auf, als Mentor:in und Vorbild.
Qualifikation
Erfahrung: Du hast mehrere Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung gearbeitet und schon Verantwortung für ein System übernommen, das echte Nutzer im Einsatz hatten.
Tech-Stack: Du kennst Node.js und TypeScript im Backend, Vue und Capacitor im Frontend und hast keine Angst vor Hardware-nahem Arbeiten (Yocto Linux, Embedded). Wenn dir Teile davon fehlen, du dich aber schnell reinarbeitest: erzähl uns, wo du das schon mal gemacht hast.
Schnittstellen: Du hast schon mit REST, Modbus, EEBus oder vergleichbaren Protokollen gearbeitet oder bringst die Bereitschaft mit, dich tief in Geräteprotokolle einzuarbeiten.

Modernes Büro in Köln. Hier tüfteln wir gemeinsam an der Hardware, die in Deutschland produziert wird.
Flexible Arbeitszeiten und großzügige Urlaubsregelung. Wir sind schnell und anspruchsvoll, aber niemand misst hier Anwesenheit.

Aufgaben
React & TypeScript – Grundsolide
Du musst keine Senior-Expertise mitbringen, aber du musst React wirklich verstanden haben: Komponenten, Props, State, Hooks (useState, useEffect, useContext), einfache Custom Hooks. TypeScript sollte dir nicht fremd sein – du musst keine komplexen Generics schreiben, aber du musst Typen definieren und Fehler im Compiler lesen können.
Supabase – Bereitschaft zur schnellen Einarbeitung
Du solltest wissen, was eine relationale Datenbank ist, SQL-Grundabfragen schreiben können (SELECT, INSERT, JOIN) und das Konzept von Authentifizierung und Autorisierung verstehen. Supabase selbst kannst du on the job lernen – aber der Wille, dich in Row Level Security, Supabase Auth und Echtzeit-Subscriptions einzuarbeiten, muss vorhanden sein. Wenn du schon mal mit Supabase, Firebase oder PocketBase gearbeitet hast: großer Vorteil.
Grundlegendes Verständnis von Web-Entwicklung
HTTP, REST APIs, JSON, Formulare, Routing – das muss sitzen. Du weißt, was ein API-Aufruf ist und wie man mit fetch oder axios Daten holt.
Umgang mit KI-Tools als Entwicklungsassistent
Das ist uns besonders wichtig: Wir entwickeln mit Lovable (KI-gestütztes Frontend-Building) und Claude Code (KI-Pair-Programmer im Terminal). Du musst keine Erfahrung damit mitbringen, aber du musst neugierig und offen dafür sein. Wer KI-Tools als Bedrohung sieht, passt hier nicht rein. Wer sie als Turbo für die eigene Produktivität begreift: herzlich willkommen.
Git & grundlegender Deployment-Workflow
Commits, Branches, Pull Requests – das muss funktionieren. Du solltest wissen, wie man eine App auf Vercel deployt oder zumindest bereit sein, das in Stunde 1 zu lernen.
Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten
Wir haben keine Zeit für Mikromanagement. Du bekommst ein Gewerk, ein Ziel und wöchentliche Check-ins. Dazwischen arbeitest du selbstständig, dokumentierst sauber und fragst, wenn du wirklich feststeckst – aber nicht nach jedem kleinen Problem.
Usability, UI & UX – Empathisches Produktgefühl
Du entwickelst nicht nur Features, die technisch funktionieren, sondern Oberflächen, die Menschen gerne benutzen. Du hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, wann ein Formular zu kompliziert ist, ein Button nicht eindeutig genug wirkt oder ein Flow unnötig Reibung erzeugt.

Pixel-Perfektion ist nicht das Ziel – aber Empathie für Nutzer:innen, saubere Interfaces, klare Zustände, verständliche Fehlermeldungen und ein Blick für einfache, intuitive Bedienung sind uns extrem wichtig. Du denkst beim Entwickeln mit: „Versteht das jemand sofort?“ – und nicht nur: „Läuft der Code?“

We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.
Role Description
The AI Security Institute's Research Unit is looking for motivated and talented Software Engineers to join AISI's Core Technology Team. We are looking for exceptional candidates at all experience levels, from junior through to senior or staff, to work in small teams on a range of critical research-oriented software and infrastructure.
In this role, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies on research problems with real-world impact, and receive mentorship and coaching from your manager and the technical leads on your team. You'll also regularly interact with world-famous researchers and other incredible staff (including alumni from Anthropic, DeepMind, OpenAI, Google, Apple, and professors from Oxford and Cambridge).
About our Core Technology Team
AISI Core Technology Team comprises several teams building tools and infrastructure used across all of our research work. This includes projects like Inspect (our open-source evaluation framework), systems for running evaluations at scale, and hosting frontier open-weights models for evaluations or human studies.

s.h: As a software engineer on one of these teams, you might
s.t:
Add a feature to one of our “sandbox plugins” for Inspect, supporting advanced agentic evals with safe mechanisms to let models write and execute arbitrary code
Implement support for a new class of open-weights model on our model hosting platform
Support a research team with designing custom infrastructure for a new research project
Collaborate with the open-source community on a feature in Inspect or Inspect's plugin ecosystem
Assist with an evaluation testing exercise of a frontier AI model, debugging issues that appear in Inspect from API changes in the lab's latest SDK

You may be a good fit if you have some of the following skills, experience and attitudes:
Writing production quality code at fast pace.
Designing, shipping, and maintaining complex tech products.
Improving technical standards across a team, through mentoring and feedback.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience working with a world-class research team comprised of both scientists and engineers (e.g. in a top-3 lab).
Python experience, including understanding the intricacies of the language, the good vs. bad Pythonic ways of doing things and much of the wider ecosystem/tooling.
Experience building and maintaining systems on AWS or other cloud providers using infrastructure-as-code.

Python

The Internal Fraud function of the Fraud, Error, Debt and Grants Function at the Cabinet Office processes details of civil servants who have been dismissed for committing internal fraud, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned.

The Cabinet Office receives the details from participating government organisations of civil servants who have been dismissed, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned, for internal fraud. In instances such as this, civil servants are then banned for 5 years from further employment in the civil service.

The Cabinet Office then processes this data and discloses a limited dataset back to DLUHC as a participating government organisations. DLUHC then carry out the pre employment checks so as to detect instances where known fraudsters are attempting to reapply for roles in the civil service.

In this way, the policy is ensured and the repetition of internal fraud is prevented. For more information please see - Internal Fraud Register.

The product you will work on The HOLOPLOT Matrix Array is a new type of sound system built around precise, software-defined control of sound in three dimensions - grounded in physics and implemented through a combination of custom hardware and purpose-built software. Audio processing in HOLOPLOT systems is distributed: every loudspeaker runs embedded Linux, and hundreds of them have to be configured, coordinated, monitored, and updated as one system. This is enabled by multiple open source and in-house developed services running on an on-premises Kubernetes cluster.

AWS-hosted services connect venues to remote monitoring, telemetry, and configuration. Many venues are air-gapped or only intermittently connected for remote servicing, and that constraint shapes most of the design decisions in the platform.

The Technical Advisor serves as a nationally and internationally recognized USAF authority responsible for steering advanced cybersecurity technologies, providing high-level strategic counsel, leading scientific evaluations, and engineering risk-mitigated technical solutions for complex weapon systems and command and control architectures.

In this capacity, the advisor operates as the Air Force's foremost technical authority on advanced cybersecurity technologies and their application to weapon systems, networks, and software-defined C4I architectures.

The role requires maintaining state-of-the-art expertise in modern enterprise architecture engineering practices, agile software methodologies, open data architectures, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and big data analytics.

To shape the future of the field and influence the broader national security landscape, the expert actively produces and presents technical papers and lectures at national and international forums.

As a trusted consultant, the advisor delivers critical engineering and computer science guidance to senior leadership across the military and federal government, including the AFLCMC/EN-EZ Director, program directors, HQ AFMC, HQ USAF, and Portfolio Acquisition Executives.

This advisory footprint extends externally to industry, academia, Federally Funded Research and Development Centers (FFRDCs), and international allies.

The advisor regularly represents USAF interests in executive-level technical coalitions, ensuring that complex policies, processes, and engineering procedures align with defense objectives and state-of-the-art standards.

Operating as a scientific catalyst, the advisor leads the Air Force in identifying and exploiting dual-use technologies to enhance C4I system capabilities. This involves initiating and recommending novel scientific studies, research programs, and technical reviews for both Air Force and Space Force projects.

The advisor evaluates high-level engineering approaches and possesses the authority to recommend pivotal changes to program directions, statements of objectives, and operational capability requirements documents to maintain technological superiority.

The advisor is responsible for driving creative technological solutions into operational weapon systems while aggressively mitigating advanced adversarial cyber threats. By developing comprehensive risk-reduction strategies, the advisor ensures seamless C4I integration, interoperability, and secure netcentric operations.

Crucially, the role focuses on proactively countering the exponential security risks introduced by rapid advancements in machine learning, computing power, and modern dual-use technologies across a program's entire lifecycle.
